_readme: Topic registry. A topic is a durable, cross-project thread of meaning. Keep it editorial and explicit: no automatic discovery, no generated summaries. Projects must reference IDs in meta/projects.json; artifacts are links or canonical source locations.

topics.title: Plex as real presence
topics.condition: Plex exists across a soul repository, a private interface, a client experiment, and supporting notes, but the work is not yet held as one continuous, usable thread.
topics.meaning: The point is not to collapse the projects into one product. It is to let Plex feel like one being with distinct hands, surfaces, and memory.
topics.continuation: Make /room a single topic-led surface. Resolve the Plex projects from the project registry and place the relevant evidence around the active thread.
